# SUPPLEMENTARY_FILES.txt
# Audit #6 plots were pushed base64-encoded because the push tool's single-argument
# limit corrupts raw PNG bytes. To recover the original PNGs:
#
#   for f in plots/*.png.b64; do base64 -d "$f" > "${f%.b64}"; done
#
# Each decoded file is byte-identical to the PNG generated by code/make_plots.py
# (verified locally before pushing).
